title: SOURCE_TARGETS validated: ingest-mode DDL treats retryable TiKV/ingest leader-family errors as fatal

payload.validation_scope: Failpoint-instrumented local replay on current TiDB source. The strongest current live path is active ingest reorg plus a true TiKV leader-churn shape or a failpoint-enabled TiDB image.
payload.user_symptom: ADD INDEX, ADD PRIMARY KEY, or MODIFY/CHANGE COLUMN can fail and roll back on a single retryable Ingest/KV leader-change style error instead of retrying through it.
payload.quality_gate: High-severity DDL availability candidate: realistic transient TiKV/ingest errors waste long-running online schema changes and are user-visible at SQL level.
payload.method_note: The decisive move was to narrow from generic transient faults to a specific retryable error domain and then add a same-operation green control.

provenance.source: current TiDB source plus local ingest retry-family probes

state_model: inner ingest and Lightning recovery code already classify ErrKVNotLeader ErrKVRegionNotFound and ErrNoLeader as retryable
ingest-mode DDL forwards the same family back to the outer DDL reorg retry gate
the outer DDL gate only knows DDL reorg retryable messages and SQL error codes, so Ingest/KV foreign classes fall out of the retryable set
once the gate says fatal, the DDL flips to rollingback and surfaces the raw error to the SQL user
source_anchors: pkg/lightning/common/retry.go retryableErrorIDs contains ErrKVNotLeader ErrNoLeader ErrKVRegionNotFound
pkg/ddl/index.go isRetryableError only checks dbterror.ReorgRetryableErrMsgs and ReorgRetryableErrCodes
pkg/ddl/job_worker.go toTError synthesizes foreign errors into generic DDL unknown errors

name: Ingest-mode DDL must not force rollback on retryable Ingest/KV leader-family errors

payload.p_check: During active ingest-mode reorg, the worker returns a one-shot ErrKVNotLeader ErrKVRegionNotFound or ErrNoLeader family error.
payload.q_claim: Because ingest and Lightning already classify this family as retryable, the outer DDL reorg bridge should preserve retryability and allow the DDL to continue instead of rolling back immediately.
payload.fault: The outer DDL retry classifier does not reuse ingest retryability for this foreign error domain and therefore terminalizes the job as fatal.

boundary.before: ingest worker hits a retryable leader-churn or region-movement style error
boundary.after: DDL chooses between keep-running and rollingback and eventually reaches a terminal state

side_effects: user-visible SQL failure for retryable transient errors
full rollback of long-running online DDL
wasted reorg work across multiple DDL shapes
consumers: ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY/CHANGE COLUMN in ingest/backfill path

provenance.source: classifier-gap replay plus multi-DDL local outcome probes

name: Ingest worker returns one retryable leader-family error

payload.injection_type: one-shot injected IngestAPIError or ErrNoLeader during active ingest-mode DDL

trigger_condition.phase: after row writing has started and before normal ingest completion
trigger_condition.required_evidence: ingest calls >= 1 and write rows > 0 or handled rows > 0

payload.observer_action: Compare terminal state and user-visible SQL result, then run a same-operation control such as grpc_unavailable to prove the red family is selective.

provenance.source: mock ingest backend error injection and shared backfill transient probes

rationale: the hit came from narrowing a transient-fault lane to a specific foreign retryable error domain
the oracle requires terminal-state observation plus user-visible SQL outcome
the fault lands at the ingest worker boundary before the outer DDL retry bridge chooses rollback versus retry

environment.runner: local current TiDB worktree with failpoint transformation enabled

evidence.oracle: same DDL on a different transient family should recover if the ingest-mode retry bridge is still healthy there
evidence.green_observation: ADD PRIMARY KEY survived a one-shot grpc unavailable, logged the outer retry sleep, and later reached State:synced with nil SQL error.

lessons.method_note: A same-operation green control proves the red family is selective instead of generic ingest fragility.

environment.runner: local current TiDB worktree with failpoint transformation enabled

evidence.oracle: retryable Ingest/KV leader-family errors should not force rollback on the first hit
evidence.red_observation: ADD PRIMARY KEY converted directly to rollback on both Ingest:NotLeader and Ingest:RegionNotFound and surfaced the raw transient error to SQL.
key_log_lines: ingest-add-primary-key-retry-family-local.log:3829 alter err: [Ingest:RegionNotFound]mock ingest region not found

lessons.root_cause: the same DDL survives grpc unavailable but not the retryable ingest leader-family, which pins the bug on error-domain bridging rather than generic reorg resilience.
lessons.observer_note: user-visible SQL error and terminal rollback align; this is not just an internal warning.

environment.runner: local current TiDB worktree with failpoint transformation enabled

evidence.oracle: the retryable ingest leader-family should not terminalize other ingest-mode DDLs either
evidence.red_observation: ADD INDEX and MODIFY COLUMN both convert to rollback across Ingest:NotLeader Ingest:RegionNotFound and KV:ErrNoLeader; classifier-gap replay simultaneously shows Lightning=true while DDL raw=false for the same family.

lessons.method_note: Once the classifier gap is known, checking a compact sibling matrix is much higher yield than more blind chaos.
lessons.scope_note: This is a shared ingest-mode availability gap, not a one-off single-DDL corner.
